business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fractional CFO Advisory and Multicurrency Ledger Bookkeeping

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – Civil Law for Quebec private and commercial obligations (Civil Code of Québec, Book Two, Arts. 2236–2271 for limited partnerships) within a federal Common Law framework
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA, Canada–EU)
Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP)
Canada–China Foreign Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (FIPA)
Canada–United States Tax Convention (1980, as amended by 2007 Protocol)
Canada–United Kingdom Tax Convention and Canada's broader network of 90+ tax treaties and DTAs, together with the OECD Multilateral Instrument

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Proceeds of Crime (Money Laundering) and Terrorist Financing Act, S.C. 2000, c. 17 (PCMLTFA) and related FINTRAC Regulations; Criminal Code, R.S.C. 1985, c. C-46; United Nations Act, S.C. 1999; Special Economic Measures Act, S.C. 1992, c. 17; Freezing Assets of Corrupt Foreign Officials Act, S.C. 2011, c. 24; Quebec Civil Code of Québec Arts. 2236–2271 (Limited Partnership); Act respecting the publicity of enterprises, individuals, partnerships and trusts, SQ 2022, c. 29, replacing CQLR c. P-45, with Registraire des entreprises du Québec (REQ) mandatory integrity and beneficial ownership declarations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport of each general partner and each 25%+ UBO, with notarized identity attestation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary public in the country of residence; notarization by a locally licensed notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Canada acceded, effective 11 January 2024, issued by Global Affairs Canada or the competent authority of the originating state); otherwise Consular Legalization at the Canadian embassy or consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or registered address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 90 days) for each general partner and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated financial institution in the origin country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or registry excerpt for each corporate general partner in its foreign register
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the foreign jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Name reservation certificate and French-language trade-name certificate issued by the Registraire des entreprises du Québec
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registraire des entreprises du Québec (Quebec Business Registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestically issued; no apostille required unless subsequently re-certified for foreign good-standing purposes

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or professional credential evidence (e.g., CPA Canada designation) for the CFO-services general partner, supporting FINTRAC-compliant KYC onboarding
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Deposit-taking institution in Canada or recognized professional order
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization only if the receiving foreign authority requires the document to be authenticated

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all partners, directors, authorized signatories, and 25%+ UBOs against FINTRAC PCMLTFA risk indicators, OSFI guidance, Public Safety Canada sanctions enforcement, UN Consolidated List, Global Affairs Canada lists under the Special Economic Measures Act and Freezing Assets of Corrupt Foreign Officials Act, and OFAC SDN list for USD clearing. Domestic and foreign politically exposed persons are screened at enhanced due diligence levels per the PCMLTFA Politically Exposed Persons Regulations and FINTRAC Guidance 4. As a customer of Stripe Billing and Wise, the LP must satisfy the payment providers' ongoing KYC, AML, and transaction monitoring requirements.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registraire des entreprises du Québec – Quebec Business Registry (Registre des entreprises du Québec), online self-service portal: https://www.registreentreprises.gouv.qc.ca
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Charter of the French Language (CQLR c. C-11, as amended by SQ 2022, c. 14, the Act respecting the official and common language of Quebec, French) requires the registered business name to be in French. The REQ will reject names that are not decidedly French in form or that are primarily anglicized unless accompanied by a French version or distinctive French descriptor. For a limited partnership, the corporate designator must be 'Société en commandite' or the abbreviation 'S.E.C.'; foreign marks may be transliterated phonetically into French spelling but must include a French-language business activity descriptor.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Quebec / Québec (as a prefix implying state affiliation without REQ or ministerial authorization)
Canada (federal official name usage without federal authorization)
Any term that is false, misleading, or falsely suggests a public or regulated body
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon REQ refusal of a proposed name, the applicant receives a written decision citing the statutory ground. The applicant may: (1) file a new name reservation request with a revised French-dominant trade name; (2) file a formal application for review (demande de révision) with the Registraire des entreprises du Québec under the Act respecting the publicity of enterprises, within 30 days of the refusal, attaching legal argumentation, trademark searches, and evidence of distinctiveness; (3) if the Registraire confirms the refusal, seek judicial review before the Court of Québec (division administrative) within the applicable 30-day appeal period. An administrative appeal does not extend the 90-day reservation period; a back-up name should be reserved concurrently to avoid blocking the incorporation timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permitted. Quebec law requires the LP declaration to disclose an establishment address in Quebec for service of process and document retention. A virtual office or registered agent address is acceptable for service, but the general partner must maintain substantive business records, including multicurrency ledger working papers and CFO advisory engagement files, at a verified physical location in Quebec or at an accessible situs recognized by the Registraire. A purely commercial mail-forwarding virtual office without a verifiable Quebec establishment is non-compliant for an active virtual CFO consultancy and will likely fail Stripe Billing and Wise KYC validation of a physical business address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for this industry at approximately 10–15% annualized probability of an unannounced REQ compliance visit or FINTRAC records examination. Likelihood escalates materially if nominee general partners, inconsistent registered-office addresses, or incomplete UBO declarations are detected.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff and REQ integrity check; conservatively budgeted for UBO amendments and restated declarations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public / Global Affairs Canada or foreign competent authority

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Quebec-licensed registered corporate service provider or legal technology physical-presence provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: CAD 350–500 per annum for base registered-office service

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Civil Code of Québec (CQLR c. CCQ-1991), arts. 2236-2262 (contrat de société en commandite / limited partnership); Act respecting the legal publicity of enterprises (CQLR c. P-44.1), arts. 10-17 (immatriculation) and arts. 26-29 (name rules and review); Professional Code (CQLR c. C-26) and Public Accountancy Act (CQLR c. C-48.1) applicable only if reserved audit/review acts are rendered. The Québec Business Corporations Act (CQLR c. S-31.1) does not govern this partnership vehicle.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registraire des entreprises du Québec (REQ) — Quebec Enterprise Registrar, exclusively through the online CliquezJustice (REQ) portal for name reservation, immatriculation and annual updates.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration d'immatriculation — Declaration of Registration of a Société en commandite (Limited Partnership)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None — the Civil Code of Québec imposes no minimum paid-up capital, government escrow, or capitalization threshold for a limited partnership. Contributions (apports) of the commandité and commanditaire are fixed freely in the partnership agreement; a limited partner must contribute money or property in exchange for its interest, not mere services, and the aggregate contribution sum is only optionally published in the REQ register.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) the general partner accepts the initial limited partner's capital subscription as set out in the Partnership Agreement; (2) the registered office is established at the Quebec address specified therein; (3) the general partner shall file the Declaration of Registration with the Registraire des entreprises du Québec and obtain the enterprise number (NEQ); (4) [Name] is appointed manager (gérant) with authority to open bank accounts, execute client agreements, engage personnel and bind the partnership in the ordinary course; (5) the partnership may lawfully provide fractional CFO advisory and multicurrency bookkeeping services; (6) pre-formation acts of the founders are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registraire des entreprises du Québec (REQ) — electronic name reservation function inside the CliquezJustice portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Run a preliminary NUANS-style search in the REQ name index; select a name comprising a distinctive element, a descriptive element, and a legal element ('S.E.C.' or 'L.P.'); submit the requête de réservation de nom with the general partner's identifier and pay the C$36 online fee (C$46 paper); the name will be rejected if confusingly similar or containing a prohibited term. The French-language version must predominate in all commercial documents under the Charter of the French Language (Bill 96).
required_dossiers: REQ name reservation application (formulaire de réservation de nom)
Full legal name, birth date and address of the general partner (or registration number if a legal person)
Proposed corporate-style name, bilingual version optional but French compulsory
Sector of activities declaration (ISIC 6920 / NAICS 541219)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused for lack of distinctiveness or prohibited wording, file a new application with a modified name or request a reasoned name authorization under the applicable REQ regulation; the REQ decision may then be reviewed by the Registrar and ultimately appealed to the Court of Québec within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the limited partnership agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding parties internally with Québec counsel; notarization optional and not required for registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the contrat de société en commandite under CCQ arts. 2236-2262. The instrument must identify the commandité (unlimited liability) and the commanditaire (liability limited to contribution), the capital and conditions of contributions, profit and loss allocation, the name and address of the gérant (manager), governance quorum, transfer restrictions and dissolution events. The French text is authoritative for legal publicity purposes. Limited partners must sign a stipulation confirming they will take no part in management in order to preserve limited liability.
required_dossiers: Limited partnership agreement (French or bilingual, French prevailing)
Limited partner consent letters confirming non-participation in management
Address for service and registered office acceptance from the premises owner
Proposed gérant's consent, civic address and professional background
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any internal inconsistency is cured by a rectifying deed or a supplemental agreement signed by all partners; if a limited partner has inadvertently exercised management powers, the protective remedy is immediate execution of a cure deed and withdrawal of the relevant powers with retroactive effect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of the Declaration of Registration with REQ
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registraire des entreprises du Québec — immatriculation online service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Electronically file the Declaration of Registration (art. 10-17 of CQLR c. P-44.1): select 'société en commandite' as the juridical form; enter the reserved name, the registered office in Québec, the general partner's identification (mandatory) and, optionally, the limited partners' names, domiciles and aggregate contributions; pay the C$59 online fee (C$80 paper filing); upon processing REQ issues the 11-digit enterprise number (NEQ) and the Attestation d'immatriculation.
required_dossiers: Déclaration d'immatriculation completed online
Name reservation certificate (attestation de réservation)
Certified extract of the partnership agreement or notarial deeds
Proof of address of each general partner
Digital authentication credentials for the REQ user (CliquezJustice account)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If REQ issues a notice of refusal or places the file under examination, respond in writing within the statutory period with rectified particulars; if the notice is confirmed, submit an amended declaration or appeal the decision before the Court of Québec; alternatively, a fresh declaration may be filed with a corrected name or address within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal business permit, fire safety certification and CNESST registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local municipality (Service des permis d'affaires / urbanisme); municipal fire prevention service; Commission des normes, de l'équité, de la santé et de la sécurité du travail (CNESST)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the municipal business licence (certificat d'autorisation) and the occupancy permit for professional-office use; coordinate a fire-safety inspection of the leasehold against the Québec Safety Code to obtain the fire compliance attestation; register the employer with CNESST (mandatory, no fee) and open the établissement file; deploy the prevention program, first-aid equipment and emergency evacuation signage.
required_dossiers: Municipal business permit application and zoning compliance certificate
Office lease and landlord's signed authorization for the intended use
CNESST employer registration form and establishment declaration
Fire safety inspection report and evacuation plan
Accessibility attestation for persons with reduced mobility
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: A zoning refusal may be contested by filing a request for a minor variance (dérogation mineure) with the municipal planning committee or by appealing to the Administrative Housing Court of Québec; a CNESST deficiency letter is cured by filing amended prevention measures within the prescribed delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate governance records, statutory registers and post-registration publicity
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Governance: general partner (internally); Registers: REQ annual declaration and business register compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the partners' register recording capital accounts, contributions and transfers; maintain minutes of general partner resolutions; ensure that the REQ file is completed with the manager appointment and the service-of-process address; adopt standard engagement letters and invoice templates bearing the legal form 'S.E.C.', the NEQ number and the registered office; fix the partnership's fiscal year-end in the agreement; verify that no reserved accountancy act is offered without a CPA practice permit.
required_dossiers: Register of partners and capital contributions
Minute book of the general partner
REQ attestation d'immatriculation and NEQ certificate
Compliant commercial templates (engagement letter, KYC file, invoices), French version prevailing
List of authorized signatories for Stripe Billing and Wise payment rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late or defective publicity is regularized by filing an amended declaration with REQ and, where applicable, by adopting a rectifying resolution of the partners; penalties for missing mandatory wording are avoided by immediate self-correction before an audit inspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipal locality: Service des permis et de l'urbanisme (business occupancy licence). For the accounting profession: Ordre des comptables professionnels agréés du Québec (CPA Québec) if, and only if, the firm performs reserved acts (audits or review engagements) under the Public Accountancy Act; pure bookkeeping and fractional CFO advisory (NAICS 541219) require no industrial production licence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificat d'autorisation d'affaires (municipal business/occupancy permit); plus, conditionally, a Permis de pratique comptable issued by the Ordre des CPA du Québec when assurance engagements are offered

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de l'Environnement, de la Lutte contre les changements climatiques, de la Faune et des Parcs (MELCCFP)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Category III project (no EIA report and no authorization certificate required): the activity is a low-footprint professional services office (virtual CFO, bookkeeping and data services) and is not listed in the Règlement relatif à l'évaluation et l'examen des impacts sur l'environnement de certains projets (CQLR c. Q-2, r. 23.1)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process wastewater or VOC point-source emissions apply. The office must nonetheless comply with municipal sewer and solid-waste by-laws; end-of-life IT equipment must be returned to a certified recycler under the Electronics Products Recovery Regulation (CQLR c. E-6.01, r. 4); energy and indoor-air requirements follow the Québec Construction Code and CNESST ventilation standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance: certification of the leasehold under the Safety Code (CQLR c. B-1.1, r. 7), including audible alarms, extinguishers, illuminated exits and a valid certificate of occupancy. Structural and accessibility clearance: building inspector approval for office occupancy (type A) under the Construction Code, including barrier-free access. Occupational health: CNESST establishment registration under the Act respecting occupational health and safety (CQLR c. S-2.1), a written prevention program, first-aid kit, and telework policy covering home-office workstation ergonomics and incident reporting.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) - federal tax administration, portal: canada.ca/en/revenue-agency; Revenu Québec - provincial tax administration for Quebec Sales Tax (QST) and Quebec income tax, portal: revenuquebec.ca
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: File the LP's declaration of registration with the Registraire des entreprises du Québec to obtain the Numéro d'entreprise du Québec (NEQ). Step 2: Obtain the federal Business Number (BN) for the LP through CRA's Business Registration Online (BRO) using the general partner's authority; non-resident general partners use Form RC372 (Application for a Non-Resident Account). Step 3: Add the GST/HST program account (RT) to the BN under the LP's name. Step 4: Register the LP for QST with Revenu Québec through the business portal to obtain the TVQ registration number. Step 5: File annual partnership information returns (T5013 to CRA; Relevé 15 to Revenu Québec) and ensure every partner holds a valid Canadian tax identifier (SIN, ITN for non-residents, or BN for corporate partners).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Canada (Banque du Canada), with functional currency administration by the federal Minister of Finance. There is no dedicated foreign-exchange control or exchange-rate management agency; OSFI supervises federally chartered banks and authorized foreign banks, while FINTRAC enforces anti-money laundering and transaction-reporting obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Canada maintains full and unrestricted convertibility on both current-account and capital-account transactions. The Canadian dollar floats freely. Profit remittances, dividends, partnership distributions, interest, royalties, and repayment of shareholder/intercompany loans are not subject to prior exchange-control approval. The only statutory hurdles are procedural: non-resident withholding taxes under Section 212 of the Income Tax Act, transfer-pricing rules under Section 247, CRS/FATCA reporting, and provincial registration requirements in Quebec. Adequate contemporaneous documentation is required to support the tax character of each flow.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Canada has no statutory export-proceeds surrender requirement, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no prescribed timeline for repatriation of export earnings. Corporate exporters may lawfully retain foreign-currency receipts in domestic or offshore bank accounts. For customs valuation and GST/QST compliance, export invoices and settlement records must be maintained in Canadian dollars using the Bank of Canada daily exchange rate; no central-bank surrender or approval is necessary.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-to-High for non-escrow, operational, cross-border payment purposes. Offshore digital EMI services such as Wise, Airwallex, and Payoneer are not chartered banks and cannot provide CDIC deposit insurance or statutory trust-account integrity required for a Canadian limited partnership's escrow arrangements. These services may be used for lower-risk disbursements and remote payments after FINTRAC MSB registration (if the EMI is deemed to be carrying on business in Canada) and, where applicable, registration with the Quebec Autorité des marchés financiers (AMF). However, the core treasury architecture should include at least one Schedule I Canadian bank account to satisfy legal, regulatory, and client-fiduciary expectations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote banking onboarding is generally permitted under Canadian standards, including for partnerships established in Quebec, provided the ultimate beneficial owners of the LP submit certified identity documents, source-of-wealth declarations, and a duly executed partnership certificate. No general federal or provincial law requires a physical in-branch interview. However, Schedule I banks may in practice require a physical meeting or a notarized attorney-attested interview for non-resident, significant-ownership, or politically exposed person (PEP) cases. A bonded registered agent with a Quebec business address materially reduces the need for situs visits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed limited partnership without audited financial statements and negligible operating history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Production of notarized partnership agreement, registraire des entreprises Quebec attestation, employer/legal counsel reference letter, 24-month projected A/R schedule, and a description of the exact client workflow for virtual CFO services.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owner of a Quebec LP seeking cross-border inbound capital transfers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport/citizenship proof, utility bill and bank statement from source jurisdiction, tax identification / national insurance number, evidence of lawful source of funds (employment contract, sale deed, inheritance deed, or share certificate), and an independent background report from a recognized compliance data provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Receipt of intercompany or shareholder loans without commercial rationale
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed loan agreement at arm's length terms, board/partner resolution, transaction purpose code, detailed explanation of treasury need (e.g., working capital for outsourced CFO contracts), and professional advice confirming that transfer pricing and thin-capitalization rules are satisfied.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-frequency receipt of third-party professional fees that may resemble fund laundering or money service transactions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master service agreement with each CFM client, standardized client KYC file, evidence of dual control billing, and a robust AML/ATF compliance manual with employee training records and risk rating methodology.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing is achieved via SWIFT MT103 from a recognized foreign financial institution to the partner's / LP's RBC or National Bank account in Montreal. In the SWIFT narrative, the sender must state 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION — PARTNERSHIP ACT OF QUEBEC' or 'SHAREHOLDER LOAN — ARM'S LENGTH' together with the Department of Finance transaction code CA tax identifier, and should identify the underlying partnership agreement reference. For amounts exceeding CAD 10,000, CNB / FINTRAC is triggered; the bank will submit an FTR. The LP must maintain a capital sub-ledger showing name of contributor, date, amount in source currency, Canadian-dollar equivalent at Bank of Canada rate, and supporting wire confirmation. No Form 91-type frills or certificates are required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary rail for cleared outbound trade disbursements is SWIFT MT103; for procurement activities requiring documentary security, a commercial letter of credit (UCP600) confirmed by a Canadian Schedule I bank is used. Where the client pays in multiple currencies, internal settlement must use a dual-currency ledger integrated with Wise or Airwallex merely as a FX vehicle; however, the legal pay-out instruction should always originate from the bank's regulated treasury workstation to preserve a clear audit trail. Payments to suppliers in non-SWIFT jurisdictions may be effected via correspondent banking arrangements in the beneficiary's domicile, but such indirect routing must be documented under FINTRAC Rule 4. Additional rails include: e-transfer/XBCT for local Canadian payments, and ACH/HVAC? for receipts from US clients via the bank's US-routing link.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Cross-currency interest rate swaps (legitimate synthetic borrowing/lending context)

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) — permissible for legal hedging of exposures to restricted/high-volatility currencies but not generally required for the CAD/USD and CAD/EUR pair because the Canadian dollar is fully convertible

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Quebec Annual Declaration (Déclaration annuelle) confirming partners, registered office, and general partner information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after each anniversary date of the limited partnership's registration in the Quebec enterprise register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file for two consecutive years may lead to administrative strike-off from the register; late filing attracts monetary fines under the Act respecting the legal publicity of enterprises and suspends the evidentiary value of the registration against third parties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: T5013 Partnership Information Return (including T5013 slips and Schedule 50 for limited partners)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before March 31 following the calendar year in which the partnership's fiscal period ends (for calendar-year fiscal periods); otherwise no later than the last day of the sixth month after the fiscal period end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of CAD 100 plus CAD 25 per day late up to CAD 2,500, plus potential gross-negligence penalties if partner allocations are materially misstated; continued default may result in CRA arbitrary reassessment of partners.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: TP-600 Statement of Business Income for a Quebec Partnership (where applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same deadline as the federal T5013, generally March 31 following the calendar year-end or within six months after the fiscal period end for non-calendar-year partnerships
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties under the Quebec Taxation Act, daily penalties up to prescribed maximums, potential denial of deductions or credits to Quebec partners until the return is filed, and possible reassessment of allocated partnership income.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No automatic statutory audit is imposed on a non-reporting commercial Quebec limited partnership. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only if the LP becomes a reporting issuer, is structured as an investment fund, is required to file audited financial statements by contractual or regulatory covenant (e.g., third-party lender, partnership agreement, FINTRAC or securities registration), or if it is consolidated into a publicly accountable group on a compulsory disclosure basis.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: CPA Canada Handbook Part II (ASPE) applies as the domestic private-enterprise GAAP unless the partnership is part of a reporting-issuer group, in which case IFRS is required. The partnership maintains books on an accrual basis, with financial statements prepared consistently with the governing framework and the partnership agreement.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Because a limited partnership has no share capital, each transfer of a partnership interest is recorded in the partnership register and reflected in the next REQ annual declaration. The general partner is required to maintain and update beneficial ownership and control records in accordance with FINTRAC / AML record-keeping obligations. The annual declaration must be checked against the partnership register and updated within the filing window; material changes in general partners or registered office are filed on an event-driven basis, not merely annually.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of General Partners (appointment and resignation records)
Beneficial Ownership / Control Register (FINTRAC AML record-keeping)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250–650 per year for a registered office and commercial agent in Quebec (CAD 350–900)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory for a non-reporting service partnership; if voluntarily engaged, USD 5,500–11,000 (CAD 7,500–15,000) for a small virtual-CFO consultancy

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
